**OFFICE NOTE**

**To:** All Heads of Departments
**From:** The Registrar
**Subject:** Diwali Holiday Closure

This is to inform all Heads of Departments that the Institute will remain closed on 8 November 2026 in observance of the Diwali holiday.

Consequently, all official work and administrative activities will be suspended on this date. Regular academic classes and institutional operations are scheduled to resume on 9 November 2026.

All HODs are requested to ensure that necessary arrangements are made to secure the premises and address any urgent matters prior to the closure. Please disseminate this information to your respective faculty and staff members to ensure a smooth workflow upon resumption.

Thank you for your cooperation.

**Registrar**
